proof.detachedNode2232Meaning: reproducible proof fixture, not universal product identity

decisions: Keep exact managed runtime identity for OpenSpec 1.10.0 and Archify 2.15.0 under FLOWKIT_HOME.

Do not make exact Node 22.23.2 part of the managed-tool runtime contract; retain package.json engines.node as host compatibility truth and treat .node-version/detached Node 22.23.2 as reproducible fixtures.
Do not make pnpm a managed runtime resolution target; repository packageManager remains its package-management identity.
Resolve only the requested managed tool from the repository lock plus explicit FLOWKIT_HOME and never silently fall back to PATH/global CLI discovery.
Fail closed on malformed lock/home facts, missing runtime, package name/version mismatch, missing entrypoint, or unsupported managed tool.
Keep resolution separate from invocation: the later OpenSpec thin integration and CLI/host seams consume resolved entrypoints.
Do not build installer, downloader, updater, arbitrary tool registry, cross-platform acceptance framework, or whole-directory attestation in this Change.
Correct pre-contract repository guidance/derived architecture during implementation so bootstrap Node 22.23.2 is not misrepresented as ongoing exact managed runtime authority.
nonGoals: Node installer or exact Node patch lock
